description: c126 (2026-05-18): exercise the campaign auto-runner state machine for the first solo mission (Defection) and confirm it chains into the second (Investigation). Verifies CAMPAIGN.AUTO.* state transitions, the force-complete + mainEndStage path, endscreenContinue(2) advancing to the briefing dialog, and menuhandlerAcceptMission firing the next stage load. Uses --auto-campaign-fast so dwells are 0.5s rather than 4s; cutscenes still play because the DWELL_PRE state holds while playerAnyInCutscene() is true.

input_sequence.comment: boot path: --skip-intro lands in CI Training, --auto-campaign 0 arms the auto-runner at solo index 0 (Defection). BOOT state on first mainTick fires startStageAt(0).

fallback scripted exit. The auto-runner now treats full campaign completion as the stronger terminal condition; this exit only catches regressions that leave the client alive after the first-cycle assertions have already been met.
